nextAction: Complete a fresh multi-speaker meeting verification and, if deployment is requested, deploy the Gemini/Somni server configuration.
decisions: Server mixes every current publisher's Opus audio during minutes. Participants receive an acknowledgement-only notice; the notice does not gate audio capture.
Somni ASR uses the configured remote login and non-streaming PCM16 WebSocket protocol. Energy VAD suppresses long silent spans before bounded batches are sent.
Meeting summaries use only the protected server-side gemini-3.5-flash-lite gateway path; no client BYOK key or GLM fallback is used.
Live captions remain temporarily disabled in both the client and server, without deleting caption code.
risks: Mixed-batch speaker attribution uses the loudest participant and is approximate; a slow ASR upstream can cause bounded-queue drops.
Energy VAD may miss very quiet speech or pass loud background noise; the revised path needs a fresh multi-speaker real-room check.
The Somni archive does not establish the ASR model name. Credentials must come from the deployment environment and must never be committed.
The online server still has the old GLM configuration; this task did not deploy or restart it.
Pure-Go Opus decoding requires Go 1.24+, so the server Dockerfile and Go version docs were bumped.
